activity.notes: Luciano became a central architect of the modern American Mafia structure in 1931, including the Commission. The interval ends with his 1946 deportation from the United States. This Activity records historically significant organized-crime activity and does not treat the American Mafia as a sovereign polity.

sources.title: History of La Cosa Nostra — FBI
sources.citation_text: The FBI describes Luciano's rise in 1931 and his role as the first boss of the family later known as the Genovese family.

sources.title: The FBI and the American Gangster, 1924-1938 — FBI
sources.citation_text: The FBI describes Luciano as establishing the Commission and helping shape the emerging New York Mafia structure.
